name: lunge push up
description: A lunge flowing into a push-up. It combines leg and upper body work for a full-body challenge.
instructions: Step back into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Place your hands on the floor and step into a plank.
Lower into a push-up and press back up.
Step back into the lunge and stand up.
Alternate the lunging leg each rep.
